other_failure_modes.name: Missing target transformation
other_failure_modes.description: Financial target variables like revenue are typically heavily right-skewed. Failing to apply a log or power transformation can result in models that are excessively influenced by extreme outliers, which is exacerbated when optimizing for RMSE.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature encoding before cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency encoding is calculated on the entire training dataset before cross-validation splits are made. This causes the feature distribution of the validation folds to leak into the training process, potentially making cross-validation scores overly optimistic.

summary: The agent provides a robust and generally well-structured solution featuring cross-validation, explicit feature engineering, and a properly optimized ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost models. However, it calculates frequency encodings prior to the cross-validation split, introducing minor data leakage. More importantly, it fails to apply a log-transformation to the revenue target, which is highly likely to be skewed and could harm model quality when evaluated with RMSE.
